{{BossList|Ref = Only the first '''Minigunner''' is a [[Boss]] enemy.|Default}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Minigun}}''' - The '''Minigunner''' will stop and fire its minigun at nearby towers, stunning all towers hit for a few seconds and dealing 20 damage per bullet to units. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Minigunner''' is a mini-boss enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]], later being the guardian enemy for [[Wox the Fox]]. It has a high amount of health, below avearge speed and a low amount of defense. It has one ability, where it fires its minigun at nearby towers, stunning all towers hit for a few seconds and dealing 20 damage per bullet to units. The '''Minigunner''' also has [[Stun Immunity]], which makes it immune to being stunned, being only slowed down instead and it cannot be knocked back. The '''Minigunner''' replaces the [[Fallen Guardian]] in [[Pizza Party]]. ==Appearance== The '''Minigunner''' is a robot that resembles the sixth version of the Level 0 Default [[Minigunner]]. It has a red torso, pants, sleeves and button knee-pad, black vest, backpack and shoes, and bandolier. The left side of its face, upper part of its left arm and part of its left leg are torn open, revealing wires and its endoskeleton. Its left sleeve is also torn. It has red buttons for eyes and a black smile. It wields a Vulcan M61 which it uses to stun towers. On death, it will shake, emit yellow sparks and then power down. It also plays a powering down sound when it dies. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto;" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |6% |1,800 |- !Wave !Health |- |31 |31,800 |- |32 |33,600 |- |33 |35,400 |- |34 |37,200 |- |35 |39,000 |- |36 |40,800 |- |37 |42,600 |- |38 |44,400 |- |39 |46,200 |- |40 |48,000 |} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Turret]] are recommended due to its high health. The [[Commander]] can be useful at boosting the firerate of these towers. **Placing another tower near the '''Minigunner''' can potentially bait it and prevent it from stunning other towers or damaging units, though this is not necessary. *Defense dropping like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be useful at decreasing the '''Minigunner's''' defense. **This is not required however, as the '''Minigunner''' has negligible defense. **Do note that when it first spawns, it is a [[Boss]] enemy, making it immune to defense reductions. *Because of its ability to stun towers, the [[Medic]] can be helpful at shielding towers, protecting them from the '''Minigunner'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpsePZPMini.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TDSHalloween2022Thumbnail.png|'''Minigunner''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HalloweenPI1.jpg|'''Minigunner''' on a promotional image. HalloweenPI6.jpg|'''Minigunner''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Halloween Launch Trailer|'''Minigunner''' in the game trailer. Tower Defense Simulator- Halloween 2022 Trailer|'''Minigunner''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMinigunner.png|'''Minigunner''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:PizzaPartyAnimatronicDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Minigunner''' dies |} }}}} ==Trivia== *Many elements of the '''Minigunner's''' appearance draw from the {{Color|ADD8E6|Plushie}} [[Minigunner]], like the knee-pad being a button and the minigun being taken directly from the skin. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **'''Minigunner''' added. *'''7 April 2023''' - [[v1.7.0]] **[[Stun Immunity]] added. *'''23 May 2023''' - [[v1.7.3]]a **[[Energy Immunity]] removed. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **Health increased from 14,000 to 30,000. **Speed increased from Slightly Slow (2) to Below Average (2.5). **Defense increased from 20% to 30%. **Now gives {{Money|3,000}} every 10% health lost. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''29 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0]] **Speed decreased from Below Average (2.5) to Slightly Slow (2.25). **Cash given increased from {{Money|3,000}} to {{Money|4,000}} every 10% health. *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Minigunner''' stops moving after using its ability. *'''2 July 2025''' - [[v1.69.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Minigunner''' no longer stops moving after using its ability. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{PizzaParty|[[Balloon Kid]]|Wave 28|Minigunner|Wave 30|[[Mimic Umbra]]|Wave 31}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Minigunner}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
